fields.description:
Build the one-time history strip as a committed operational script and prove it on a scratch clone before any publication window. No new dependency is added: the implementation uses stock Git plumbing already required by the repository. Session log **1cb6-d553-6565-49b4** contains the measured facts.

## Why stock plumbing

The proven pipeline is `git fast-export --no-data --signed-tags=strip --export-marks=old.marks tickets | <length-aware filter> | git fast-import --export-marks=new.marks`. On the real branch, the stream carries `M 100644 <sha> <path>` records with zero inline blob data and is about 26 MB for roughly 49,900 commits, so the filter need not move the roughly 1 GiB of blobs.

The filter emits no `deleteall`; branch export carries no tag records, so `--signed-tags=strip` is a harmless no-op; merges retain their `merge :n` parents; and empty commits remain. This preserves DAG topology and each non-target file introduction point, which ancestry-based authorship verification requires. `git-filter-repo --prune-empty=never` could also preserve empty commits; stock Git is chosen because the measured pipeline is already proven and avoids a new operational dependency, not because filter-repo is incapable.

Measured rehearsal result: 1,172,586,762 bytes became 98,803,422 bytes (8.4%), with every commit and merge commit preserved and the rewritten HEAD tree byte-identical after the dynamic re-add, in about 30 seconds.

## Required corrections

1. Run only in a fresh **unfiltered** clone. `fast-import` fails with `fatal: blob not found` in a `blob:none` partial clone, and this host's normal `origin` checkout is partial.
2. Strip both `.bridge_state/` and `.bridge_state.bak-retarget/` from every historical revision. B6 ticket `3036-cb14-86b5-44a3` of epic `42eb-5789-c798-4dfc` deleted the 33,025,572-byte `.bridge_state.bak-retarget/prev_snapshot.json` from HEAD and is closed. Before recording `old-tip`, the dry run must assert that prefix is absent from the old-tip tree; the rewrite then removes its historical copies.
3. Derive the re-add set dynamically with `git ls-tree -r --name-only <old-tip> -- .bridge_state/`, never from a hardcoded list. Story `9594-1f1c-bcd1-4774` added `get_rotation.json`, so the current store has four files and future extensions must remain safe.
4. Parse every `data <n>` block by byte length instead of filtering lines with `grep`. Commit messages may begin with `M ` or `D `; those bytes are message data, not file commands.
5. Build the dry-run scratch clone with `--no-tags` (or prune all local tag refs before repack), then assert `refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z` is absent before pack measurement. A6-0c must leave both the source remote branch and this remote tag unchanged; A6-1 owns deletion of the remote tag inside its quiet-window publication procedure.

## Publication boundary

The dry-run script never pushes. A6-1 owns publication: immediately before publishing, it re-reads the observed remote tip and uses `--force-with-lease=<old-tip>:<new-tip>`, never `--force`. A lease failure means another writer moved the remote; abort publication and rerun from a fresh unfiltered clone of the new tip. A6-0d owns the verified off-repo backup bundle used for rollback. A6-1 also owns deleting remote tag `refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z` during that quiet-window publication sequence; A6-0c only proves the tag is absent from its rewritten scratch clone and unchanged on the source remote.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] [code-verifiable] On a scratch unfiltered clone, the rewritten branch commit count equals the measured old-tip commit count. Tier: repo integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] On the same clone, the rewritten branch merge-commit count equals the measured old-tip merge-commit count. Tier: repo integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] Before rewrite, the harness asserts `git ls-tree -r --name-only <old-tip> -- .bridge_state.bak-retarget/` has empty stdout, proving the recorded old tip includes closed B6. Tier: repo integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] After dynamic re-add, `rev-parse <new-tip>^{tree}` exactly equals `rev-parse <old-tip>^{tree}`. Tier: repo integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The re-add set comes from `ls-tree`, proven by a synthetic store with a fourth `.bridge_state/` file that survives byte-identically. Tier: integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The rewritten branch has no commit touching `.bridge_state.bak-retarget/`; the harness executes `test -z "$(git log --format=%H rewritten-tickets -- .bridge_state.bak-retarget/)"`. Tier: repo integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] A fresh unfiltered `--no-tags` clone of the rewritten branch has pack size at most **150 MB**, matching the parent epic ceiling. The harness first asserts `git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z` exits nonzero, then performs repack and measurement. Tier: repo measurement.
- [x] [code-verifiable] An adversarial commit message whose first line begins with `M ` survives byte-identically. Tier: unit stream-filter test.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The script refuses a `--filter=blob:none` clone with a nonzero exit. Tier: integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] That refusal writes an operator-readable remedy requiring a fresh unfiltered clone. Tier: integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] Every graph, tree, history-removal, and pack-size assertion completes before the script produces its final success result. Tier: integration with a seeded assertion failure.
- [x] [code-verifiable] A completed dry run invokes no remote push operation. Tier: integration with a recording Git wrapper.
- [x] [code-verifiable] A completed dry run leaves the source remote `tickets` ref unchanged. Tier: repo integration comparing the exact before/after object id.
- [x] [code-verifiable] A completed dry run leaves source remote tag `refs/tags/pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z` unchanged. Tier: repo integration comparing the exact before/after object id.
- [x] [code-verifiable] In temporary real clones rooted at the rewritten branch, the harness appends and pushes one representative review-bot ticket event. Tier: repo integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] After that synthetic writer push, `git merge-base --is-ancestor <old-tip> <new-tip>` exits nonzero. Tier: repo integration.
- [x] [code-verifiable] The representative writer push increases incremental `size-pack` by less than 1 MB. Tier: repo integration.

## Verification commands

- Stream-filter unit oracle: `pytest tests/unit/test_reclaim_bridge_history.py -v`.
- Synthetic four-file, partial-clone refusal, DAG/tree, history-removal, pack-size, no-publication, and representative-writer oracles: `pytest tests/integration/test_reclaim_bridge_history.py -v`.
- Repository gates: `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `make test`.

## Scope

`infra/scripts/reclaim_bridge_history.py`, `tests/unit/test_reclaim_bridge_history.py`, and `tests/integration/test_reclaim_bridge_history.py`.

Scope: M. Operationally depends on closed B6 `3036-cb14-86b5-44a3`; must close before A6-1.
